name: feldspar-sklearn
title: scikit-learn
description: Five scikit-learn estimators as model providers: ridge regression, gradient boosting, support vector machines, DBSCAN clustering and t-SNE.
supplies: A model provider, sklearn_ridge: linear regression with an L2 penalty, over standardised features.
A model provider, sklearn_gradient_boosting: boosted trees, a regressor or a classifier according to the label.
A model provider, sklearn_svm: a support vector machine, likewise.
A model provider, sklearn_dbscan: density clustering, which finds its own number of clusters and labels outliers.
A model provider, sklearn_tsne: a two- or three-dimensional embedding for plotting.
